# Review summary

Both assigned unapproved bases now have complete reviewer-ready native parametric families with exact canonical defaults, task-local adapters/contracts, source inventories, protected-Racket authoring preflights, causal witnesses, sequential public projections, and bounded adversarial evidence. This return does **not** grant owner source approval, native acceptance, or training admission.

## e0680a673043

The ordinary generator was rebuilt around the actual header/object contract with strict scalar and override validation, deterministic fresh outputs, and an independent mirror. The new episode-fixed `rank_policy` family supports `size_desc` (byte-exact canonical), `size_asc`, and `color_asc`; demonstrations force size and color orderings to disagree, and the selected-object intermediate causally controls the crop/transform stage. Final task tests pass 8/8, the 72-episode probe covers all settings with substantive 30×30 stress, the protected-Racket preflight passed 6 jobs/60 evaluations, the wrong-object witness replayed, and 24 public views passed first-turn privacy checks.

One pre-existing warning remains outside the assigned task homes: the archival bank file `shared/data/base/solutions/banks/26462ff56908/M79__e0680a673043.json` contains behavior-equivalent beautified rule text whose hash differs from active canonical authority. The detector reports sampled behavior agreement; this return intentionally does not edit that shared archival file.

## 1ba9f2a08016

The ordinary generator now rejects boolean/string/negative positional seeds and sample indices. The new episode-fixed `component_policy` family supports `plain` (byte-exact canonical), `highlight_largest`, and `highlight_smallest`; Step A constructs the canonical halo and post-halo components, and Step B recolors only the selected component's magenta cells.

A final shortcut audit found and fixed a first design where post-halo rank leaked through pre-halo red-seed count. The replacement crosses those orderings in every scene, and the retained 72-episode probe performs 144 explicit shortcut checks. Final task tests pass 14/14, all four boundaries and substantive 30×30 cases are covered, the protected-Racket preflight passed 6 jobs/60 evaluations, the wrong-component witness replayed, and 24 public views passed first-turn privacy checks.
